next_step_summary: PR #266 is the first owner-authorized bounded corrective after the provider audit. It removes gemini-3.1-pro-preview from the API route, leaving gemini-3.6-flash -> gemini-3.5-flash, validates model override before provider access, remembers daily-quota and stable 404 model-unavailable failures across later cases, and treats HTTP 401/403 as global authentication/permission failures that abort the run without model fallback. Malformed-output fallback, structured quota/retry parsing, separate bounded retry/routing budgets, attempt ledger/per-model metrics, report redaction, and guaranteed partial-report persistence remain following bounded corrective work before any new Gemini run.
